legal_form: קרן פתוחה, קרן מחקה (open tracking fund under the Joint Investment Trust Law 1994; bought and redeemed at the unit price through a distributor, not traded on the exchange, ETF-04); קרן בלתי מוגבלת בניירות ערך חוץ; exposure profile 4D. Trustee: יובנק חברה לנאמנות בע"מ. Tracking asset on Maya's fund page: MSCI WORLD INDEX - NTR 100% + דולר ארה"ב 100%. Payment policy on Maya: 'לא מתחייבת לחלק תשלומים'. REPLICATION: swap: unfunded swaps and forwards, plus ETFs on the tracking asset (annual report p. 2, 'הדרך שבה הקרן תנוהל': 'נכון למועד דוח זה, מנהל הקרן מייצר חשיפה לנכס המעקב באמצעות עסקאות החלף שאינן במימון, חוזי אקדמה (עסקאות פורוורד) וכן באמצעות ETF על נכס המעקב'). Size used to rank the fund (not a fee input): net assets 374.2 million NIS as of 2026-09-30 (Maya fund page, 'שווי נכסים').

fixed_management.notes: Fixed management fee as printed in the report: 0.31% of average annual net assets. Maya's fund page (https://maya.tase.co.il/he/funds/mutual-funds/5124573, read 2026-10-25) shows the same 'דמי ניהול' 0.31%. The manager committed to the ISA outline to raise its fees only on 1 January (ETF-16). Main prospectus published on Magna on 2025-07-01, reference 2025-03-047347 (not opened; Magna returns 403 to scripts), as the report states; the prospectus block cites this report.

variable_management.notes: p. 1 footnote 8: in force from 01.01.2026 the variable management fee rate is 0.30% (the rate as of 31.12.2025 is printed garbled in the text layer and is not copied). Maya's fund page shows 0.3%. The mechanism works in both directions (ETF-14): the amount actually charged or paid depends on the gap to the tracking asset.

tracking_difference_12m.notes: Not printed as one number. The report's table 'תשואות, סטיות תקן ונתוני השוואה' (p. 6) prints the fund's return against its tracking asset: 2025 5.43% against 4.96% (MSCI World Index 100%, US dollar 100%); 2024 21.16% against 21.37%; 2023 28.10% against 27.46%; 2022 -7.77% against -7.82%. The difference is not computed here (data-update rule). The ISA directive (ETF-07(e)) makes the manager publish the 12-month tracking difference every pricing day; this report points to the third-party page https://fundscenter.co.il/funds.shtml?m=3 for it. That page (Funds Center by Guideline, run for the managers) states on the page 'אין להפיץ בכל דרך כלשהי ... את הנתונים המוצגים באתר', so its figures are not copied here (same position as CAT-43 for TASE lists); founder decision pending.

median_spread.notes: Not applicable: an open tracking fund is bought and redeemed at the unit price computed from net asset value, with no exchange spread. Load (שיעור הוספה): 0% on Maya's fund page. The distributor may charge its own buy and sell commission (MF-26).

fund_level_withholding_drag.notes: Not collected: the report prints no withholding figure and no computation is made here. The fund takes its exposure mainly through derivatives (see REPLICATION in legal_form), so any dividend-withholding drag sits inside the instrument pricing and is not published as a rate.

load.notes: Words as printed on page 1 of the report. A zero is the rate this report states; the maximum sits in the fund agreement (MF-21), which was not read for this record, and the report says a manager raises its pay, the load included, only at the start of a calendar year. Any commission a distributor charges on buying or selling is a tariff line, not this load.
